progression.narrative: The performance opens on Cs4 and dwells most on F# in Basteh-negar II. The line peaks at A#4 (469.5 Hz) at 0:17.0. It closes on E4, not the tonic (F#4 → Ek4 → D#4 → E4 → Ek4 → E4).
